name: How do I know if my bathroom remodel quote is missing permit costs?

mainEntity.name: How do I know if my bathroom remodel quote is missing permit costs or inspection-related fees?
mainEntity.text: How do I know if my bathroom remodel quote is missing permit costs or inspection-related fees?

acceptedAnswer.text: A quote may be missing permit-related costs if it does not clearly list who pulls the permit, how inspections are scheduled, and whether plan-check or city fees are included. Some estimates bundle these items into the total, while others exclude them entirely, which makes bids hard to compare. Homeowners should ask for a breakdown that shows permit fees, administrative time, engineering if needed, and any inspection-related delays or reinspection charges. In Los Angeles-area remodeling, permit responsibility is especially important because bathroom projects often involve plumbing, electrical, or waterproofing work. If the contractor says permits are extra, ask for the specific amount or a clear allowance. A vague answer usually means the quote is incomplete. The best way to avoid surprises is to make sure the estimate states exactly what happens if the city requests corrections or additional documentation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Ask whether the quote includes permit applications, plan checks, inspection coordination, and final sign-off. If the estimate is vague about approvals or says permit costs are extra without details, it may not reflect the real project cost. Always separate build cost from administrative cost.
